lines:
  - id: eic.h_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing a joint return for 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}

  - id: eic.h_married_sep
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household (Step 3 question 3; Step 4 question 1)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}

    label: "Number of children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC (Step 3 question 1), with or without a valid SSN"

    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}

    label: "Number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs"

    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  - id: eic.h_n_se
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of people on the return who were self-employed (filing Schedule C)"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.has_sc, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_uses_wsb
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: Were you self-employed at any time in 2025 (or filing Schedule SE as clergy or church employee, or Schedule C as a statutory employee)? Yes: use Worksheet B"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_n_se, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Clergy, church employees and statutory employees are screened (scope.schedule1); self-employment is read as having a Schedule C."

  - id: eic.h_s5a_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 3: is your earned income less than the limit for your qualifying children who have valid SSNs?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_ws_1a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 1a: Enter the amount from Schedule SE, Part I, line 3 (you and your spouse)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line2
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}
    note: "Farm and partnership amounts (Schedule SE lines 1a, 1b) are screened by person.se_screen, so Schedule SE line 3 equals line 2 (person.se_line2). Line 1b (Schedule SE lines 4b and 5a, optional method and church employee income) is likewise screened and taken as zero."

  - id: eic.h_ws_1d
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 1d: Enter the amount from Schedule SE, Part I, line 13"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line13
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_ws_1e
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 1e: Subtract line 1d from line 1c (line 1c combines lines 1a and 1b)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.h_ws_1a, take: eic.h_ws_1d}

  - id: eic.h_ws_2c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 2c: net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31, of the self-employed NOT required to file Schedule SE (line 2a, farm, is zero)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.sc_total
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_ws_1e, eic.h_ws_2c, eic.earned_income]}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1]
    shown_when: eic.h_uses_wsb
    note: "Line 3 (statutory employee Schedule C, line 1) is screened by scope.schedule1 and is zero; line 4a is the earned income from Step 5."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 4b is more than zero"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_q5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, line 5: is line 4b less than the limit for your qualifying children who have valid SSNs?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B, Part 4 passed (line 4b more than zero, line 5 answered Yes)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_pos, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_q5, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsb_ok
    note: "Part 5 is reached only when line 4b is more than zero (STOP otherwise), so the floor at zero changes no reached amount."

  - id: eic.h_s5_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5 passed (Worksheet A: question 3 Yes; Worksheet B: Part 4 passed)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5a_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_s5_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, or line 5 answered No: Check the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb_ok, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_reach_ws
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 to 5 passed; figure the credit on the worksheet"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.earned_income
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_uses_wsb, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.wsb_6
    note: "Worksheet B lines 7 to 11 repeat Worksheet A lines 2 to 6 with Worksheet B line 6 in place of line 1 (and line 8 = line 11b as line 3). Read so: on Worksheet B this line holds Worksheet B line 6 and lines 2 to 6 below serve as Worksheet B lines 7 to 11."

  - id: eic.h_l1_in
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 1 is within the EIC Table (at least $1 and less than the limit for your column)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_t0_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t1_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t2_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t3_l1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table (right after Worksheet B) to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs as defined earlier. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_in, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t0_l1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t1_l1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t2_l1
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_in, {const: true}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t3_l1
    note: "Amounts below the table's first row ($1) or at or above the column's limit ('you can't take the credit') give zero, which leads to the STOP on this line."

  - id: eic.h_line2_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 2 is more than zero (if line 2 is zero, STOP: you can't take the credit)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}

  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}

  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}

  - id: eic.h_th0o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, no qualifying children with valid SSNs ($10,620)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.other}
  - id: eic.h_th0j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, no qualifying children with valid SSNs, married filing jointly ($17,730)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_th1o
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, 1 or more qualifying children with valid SSNs ($23,350)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.other}
  - id: eic.h_th1j
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold, 1 or more qualifying children with valid SSNs, married filing jointly ($30,470)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}

  - id: eic.h_threshold
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 threshold for your qualifying children and filing status"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th0j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th0o
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: true}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th1j
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_joint, {const: false}]}]}
          then: eic.h_th1o

  - id: eic.h_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 4 answered No and line 3 is not less than the threshold (line 5 is completed)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_threshold]}

  - id: eic.h_l3_in
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 3 is within the EIC Table (at least $1 and less than the limit for your column)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.table_start}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_t0_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t1_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t2_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_t3_l3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.h_look5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 is completed and line 3 is within the EIC Table"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_show5, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_in, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "If you have no qualifying children who have valid SSNs, is the amount on line 3 less than $10,620 ($17,730 if married filing jointly)? 1 or more qualifying children who have valid SSNs, is the amount on line 3 less than $23,350 ($30,470 if married filing jointly)? Yes. Leave line 5 blank; enter the amount from line 2 on line 6. No. Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_look5, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_look5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 0, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t0_l3
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_look5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 1, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t1_l3
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_look5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 2, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t2_l3
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_look5, {const: true}]}, {op: test, ge: [eic.h_n_ssn, {const: 3, type: Count}]}]}
          then: eic.h_t3_l3
    shown_when: eic.h_show5
    note: "Blank (skipped) lines carry zero here and are not shown. A line 3 at or above the column's limit gives zero (you can't take the credit); Step 1 already stops such returns."

  - id: eic.h_min52
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Look at the amounts on lines 5 and 2. Then, enter the smaller amount on line 6."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_show5, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_min52
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_show5, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.line2

  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can take the EIC (Steps 1 to 5 passed and the worksheet credit is not zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach_ws, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line2_pos, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [scope.other_income, sa.excluded_income, scope.schedule1, scope.other_line16, eic.h_died_gate]
    note: "Form 2555 (Step 1 q3) is screened by sa.excluded_income, nonresident aliens (Step 1 q4) and passive activities by scope.other_income, Schedule E, personal property rental and Form 4797 by scope.schedule1, Form 8814 by scope.other_line16, and a decedent's or deceased spouse's age test (Step 4 q2, see Pub. 596) by eic.h_died_gate. Step 6 (credit figured by the IRS) and Form 8862 are not modeled."

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit (Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.line6
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c if you do not want to claim the earned income credit or if you have been instructed to check the box in the instructions for line 27a."
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_27c_s1, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_27c, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_27c, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach_ws, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line2_pos, {const: false}]}
    note: "Covers the instructed cases reached in the flowchart and worksheets (Step 1 q2, Step 3 q6, Step 4 q3 and q5, Worksheet B line 4b and line 5, line 2/line 7 zero). Electing not to claim the credit has no input in the closed interface and is not modeled; the nonresident alien case is screened."

  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses (Step 3, question 6 answered No)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_reach3, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_sep_path, {const: true}]}
    note: "Read as the flowchart path: Steps 1 and 2 passed, a qualifying child, not a joint return, Step 3 q3 Yes, q4 No or q5 Yes, and q6 No. Later steps do not affect this box."
```
